purpose: Define the governed bridge layer between formal RT objects and external observables.

non_claims: Does not claim empirical proof of RT Calculus.
Does not claim that empirical success makes a bridge unique.
Does not claim that failure of a bridge invalidates RT_core.
Does not collapse observables into formal objects.

bridge_definition.reading: A governed correspondence between a formal RT object and an independently defined observable.

governed_separation: Formal object exists independently of the empirical mapping.
Observable is defined independently of RT terminology.
Bridge evidence can support or contradict a bridge hypothesis without rewriting the formal calculus.

bridge_components.name: Bridge Hypothesis
bridge_components.definition: A provisional claim of correspondence between a formal RT object and an observable.

bridge_components.name: Bridge Evidence
bridge_components.definition: Support or contradiction for a bridge hypothesis.
